hedges.reason: Gold is the closest expression of the debasement shock that would push silver's front month through $120. Silver trades as a high-beta version of gold, so a silver move that big almost has to come with gold settlements rising well above their current range.
This covers the extreme upside that would take out C6 ($150 silver). That scenario needs a disorderly precious-metals melt-up, and in it gold would also push to its far upper rungs.

In the dollar-credibility or dovish-Fed world, markets would price, and the Fed would probably deliver, cuts by mid-year. A June 25 bp cut is the most direct rate expression of the falling real yields that drive a precious-metals squeeze.

claims.reason: Silver cannot plausibly reach a $120+ front-month settlement without the monetary-metal bid that moves gold too. Silver's beta to gold is above 1, so a silver breakout to new cycle highs implies gold settling well above its current range, at least the moderate upside rungs.

$150 silver would be a full-blown precious-metals mania, roughly doubling from the likely current level. The only mechanism is an extreme flight from the dollar and from real rates, and that would also carry gold to its far upper rungs.
